title: NEMAFI - ISP Landing Page
description: Modern landing page for NEMAFI, an Internet Service Provider (ISP). Features a dark, sleek UI displaying fiber plans, speeds up to 500 Mbps, and AI-powered recommendations for seamless connectivity.

title: NMBT - Nordic Travel Portal
description: A visually immersive travel platform for Nordic Mountain Bound Travelers (NMBT). Built with beautiful typography and large landscape imagery to inspire mountain exploration.

title: Vouki - Event Discovery Platform
description: A comprehensive web application for discovering and organizing local events. The platform features event cards, categories like food, technology, and art, and a clean, user-friendly interface.

title: PD. Batu Hias - Admin Dashboard
description: A robust administrative dashboard built for PD. Batu Hias to track daily transactions and revenue. Features interactive charts, dark mode UI, and financial summary cards.

title: Djaman Coffee - Cafe Website
description: An elegant and warm website for Djaman Coffee. Designed to showcase their crafted daily coffee, menu, and reservation system with a natural, green-tinted aesthetic.

title: Project B - Museum Booking App
description: A minimal, modern booking interface for art exhibitions. Allows users to explore curated contemporary masterpieces and seamlessly select dates and times for their visit.

title: Ceramics E-Commerce App
description: A premium mobile e-commerce application for selling ceramic goods. Features a soft, earthy color palette, category navigation, and beautiful product showcases for vases and mugs.

title: NoePOS - Point of Sale
description: A secure and efficient Point of Sale (POS) login interface featuring a clean PIN pad entry system and user shift history tracking for retail staff.
